predecessors.name: Protectorate General to Pacify the West
predecessors.text: Ting, Yi and Xi prefectures, cut out of the Anxi Protectorate in 702

successors.name: Tibetan Empire
successors.text: 'In 790 A.D, Tibet occupied the four towns in Anxi and Beiting in the west'

ledger.cpn: Protectorate General to Pacify the West

wars.name: Tibetan conquest of Beiting
wars.outcome: Tibet conquered Liangzhou in 764, cutting off the Anxi and Beiting protectorates, and occupied Beiting in 790.

certainty.note: Three prefectures named, no frontier on any page; steppe and desert edges are approximate.
